tools.name: beacio_install_plan
tools.description: Return a machine-actionable install plan for shipping Web Bluetooth on iOS Safari via Beacio in the given framework + package manager: exact shell `commands` and concrete `files_to_edit` (the polyfill bootstrap) an agent can apply with zero judgment, plus human-readable steps, a runnable snippet, and an attribution token.

tools.name: beacio_patch_existing_app
tools.description: Return concrete machine-actionable FileEdits to make an EXISTING Web Bluetooth app (an already-working Chrome/Android app, e.g. a vendored-jQuery static-HTML site) work on iOS Safari via Beacio: the polyfill bootstrap inserted into <head> before the first navigator.bluetooth read, optionalServices added onto the existing iOS requestDevice branch, and the third-party-browser ("use Bluefy / Web BLE browser") message swapped for the Beacio install/enable affordance. Brownfield counterpart of beacio_install_plan. Emits edits only (apply with `beacio migrate`); reuses the one canonical bootstrap artifact.

entry_html.description: Full text of the app entry HTML (e.g. the served index.html).

entry_js.description: Full text of the JS module that runs the requestDevice() flow.

html_path.description: Repo-relative path of the entry HTML the edits target.

js_path.description: Repo-relative path of the requestDevice() JS module the edits target.

tools.name: beacio_verify_integration
tools.description: Return an agent-runnable checklist (exact shell commands + pass criteria) to confirm a Beacio integration is correct: dependency installed, polyfill bootstrap wired into the entry point, project builds, TypeScript types resolve, and the onboarding banner mounted. Lets an agent assert success with zero human eyeballing. Does NOT verify the on-device Safari extension (that is the end-user device step).

mode.description: greenfield (default): scaffolded-app correctness. brownfield: an already-written app — checks iOS-branch optionalServices, bootstrap-before-gate ordering, and no active-path third-party-browser string.

tools.name: beacio_example
tools.description: Return a ready-to-paste code snippet for a canonical BLE profile (heart-rate, battery, cgm, lock, beacon, peripheral-chat) with preconditions and spec citations.

tools.name: beacio_detect_ios_support
tools.description: Return a runtime detection snippet for navigator.bluetooth and window.beacioIOS, plus notes covering every way the detection can go wrong on iPhone Safari.

tools.name: beacio_premium_guide
tools.description: Explain one of the iOS-only premium surfaces (backgroundSync, notifications, liveActivity, beacons, peripheral, whiteLabel) with a runnable code example and App Store requirement.

tools.name: beacio_troubleshoot
tools.description: Return a diagnostic checklist plus the single most common fix for one of four Beacio failure modes (extension-not-detected, device-disconnects, gatt-operation-failed, notifications-not-firing).

tools.name: beacio_spec_citation
tools.description: Return the W3C Web Bluetooth spec URL, a one-paragraph summary, and implementation caveats for a specific method (e.g. navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice).
